additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0443787-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/RN 300000003009] Faulty Socket CRM:02699000158
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I will take over the ticket from here. The issue was caused by a lost communication between our SECC and PLC. I restarted the SECC Docker container, and the problem is now resolved.
In the unlikely event that the issue reoccurs, please reboot the charger via OCPP and raise a ticket. We will escalate it to our R&D team for further investigation.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
